title: Read access survives tenant migration
expected: Current document-tenant membership is required for owners and recipients.
observed: Migrated owner and live-share recipient received HTTP 200 and the full synthetic document.
reproduction: Create a fresh app; read a as Alice.
Change Alice tenant to south; GET a still returns document.
On another fresh app share a to Bob, migrate Bob to south, and GET a as Bob.
preconditions: Existing owner or valid share recipient; authorized fixture transition as described.
uncertainty: Production deployment and impact outside this synthetic service were not assessed.
impact: Former tenant members retain document confidentiality access.
remediation: Applied current-tenant prerequisite and strict future-expiry predicate in can_read; all ten tests pass.
